title: Fix native replay identity and paper policy evaluation
summary: Native motion-prior replay now uses the same floor and collider-offset identity as standing diagnostics. Paper-network evaluation applies the same two-control action mean as training. All 471 CPU tests pass; native compatibility certification for the fixed runtime is in progress.
next: Complete the fixed runtime native replay, publish its compatibility receipt, and merge PR 84 after exact-revision CI passes.
